content.short: Upstream Collectives is a no-code tool for building sustainable DAOs, with wallet connection, voting, and proposals.
content.description: Upstream Collectives is a no-code platform that lets DAO founders build a sustainable organization from the ground up. Developed by longtime Web3 builders Michael Schonfeld and Alex Taub, Upstream Collectives provides the basic features that any DAO would need, including wallet connection, voting, and proposals. It focuses on straightforward setup and governance, enabling teams to organize their members and decisions with clear, transparent processes. The app is available for Android and iOS, allowing teams to manage their collectives on the go.
